changes: Improved performance in water-heavy areas without reducing graphics quality.
Improved VR frame pacing by removing the native frame-rate ceiling.
Fixed night-vision lighting losing alignment with the headset.
Fixed camera-position drift after sprinting and vaulting obstacles.
Removed hit-induced view rotation and zoom by default; the original distortion can be restored in settings.
known_issues: Some scripted grabs and other screen effects can still feel off in VR.
Physical camcorder controls remain experimental and are off by default.
